dct_title_s: Damage Assessment of San Pascual Municipality, Northeastern Part of the Masbate Region, Bicol Region Province
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20191202PHL** This map illustrates satellite-based structural damage assessment in San Pascual municipality in the northeastern part of Masbate region, Bicol Region province, in the Philippines. The area was affected by Typhoon Kammuri that made landfall on 3 December 2019. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 16 potentially damaged structures around San Pascual town, in the San Pascual municipality, within the extent of this map. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
